strengths.finding: The rig protects the chosen little character rather than enlarging anatomy to solve acting. Four individually hinged wings sit behind the torso; short hands reach the face through head staging. The updated thinking and focused poses separate the lower mittens while preserving the oversized head and stub feet.

Theme parity is structurally strong: one renderer changes paint, edge treatment and glint. Antenna edges copy the actual bent paths. Application exports reuse the same rig and crop the existing head instead of redrawing it.

Measured: all nine motion tests passed locally. They cover the 24-clip numeric contract, finite completion, no remaining scheduled frames, deterministic reduced motion, interruption continuity and a continuously descending hop. The exact hop sheet visibly retains four connected wing panels and compact proportions.

concreteConcerns.finding: The updated thinking chin mitten still meets several ruff and jaw contours; grateful intentionally gathers both mittens against the ruff. These areas remain denser than the otherwise clean silhouette. This is a reading concern, not evidence of detached limbs or permission to enlarge hands.

The inspected test suite loads motion.js but never character.js. Passing hand-distance and wing-angle assertions therefore does not establish rendered attachment, unobstructed eyes, export bounds or theme geometry equality. Numeric uniqueness of 24 settled poses likewise does not establish perceptually distinct acting.

Interrupted motion carries bounded velocity then clamps channels and hand reach. This is sensible protection, but the tests exercise selected compatible switches; the supplied sheets cannot establish visual continuity for every cross-family interruption, particularly while the hop is airborne.

qualityCriteriaForNine: Keep exact shared geometry and numeric poses across themes; preserve four connected wings, tiny mittens, attached feet and unequal continuous antennae.

At the intended application sizes, inspect current rendered key poses and interruption frames in both themes: no clipping, floating pieces, accidental facial occlusion or confusing hand/ruff tangencies.
Verify difficult interruption cases visually as well as numerically, and retain finite playback and static reduced-motion choices.
Require expressive clarity and appealing timing in actual playback. Test success and an agent score cannot certify creative excellence or audience recognition.
highestValueExperiment: Make one compact renderer-based proof sheet and playback sequence covering thinking/focused/grateful hand contact, excited-to-sad interrupted during descent, and a rapid reflective-to-joy switch. Show both themes at the actual minimum intended sizes. Adjust only staging or timing where reviewers can identify a concrete defect; add narrow regression checks for confirmed defects.
limits: Source inspection, two supplied evidence sheets and nine executed tests; no new browser session or real-time playback. No prior review or score read. Website architecture is outside this assessment. Human attachment, unaided recognition and delayed recall remain unmeasured.
